name: Stockton & Darlington Railway: Middleton St George (Fighting Cocks)
notes: New area for the S&DR bicentenary. Cabinet resolved to designate it on 6 May 2025; the appraisal records the adoption of the final boundary on 17 July 2025 (HE date of designation 17/07/2025). HE holds it with UID 0, so the council layer feature 'Middleton St George' is used.
